player_prompt.intro:
Nawe ngumdlali {player_id}. Udlala umdlalo we-Battleship.
Inhloso yakho kukhuluphelela isikepe soke samgadli wakho ngaphambi kokuba akhuluphelele isikepe sakho.
Ekuseni kwakho, ungashaya imikhosi kuma-ko-odineyithi ngendlela leyi: '[a4]'. Uma imikhosi ikhona isikepe, ibhalwa ngalo 'X'. Uma iyahleka, ibhalwa ngalo 'O'. Kulo mongo wabo, indawo yendlalo itawu tshelela mayelana nemikhosi yakho. Uma ukhuluphelele isikepe, indawo yendlalo itaku tshelela!
Umdlalo uphela lapho isikepe soke samgadli munye sekhuluphelelwe.
Ibhodi yakho yokuqala ita ku bonisa isikepe soke sakho sesitekiwe kanye nemikhosi ya mgadli wakho kuwe, kanye nemikhosi yakho kanye nemikhosi leyi yahlekileyo ebhodini ya mgadli wakho ngaphandle kokubonisa isikepe sakhe.
Nga la ibhodi yokuqala:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Lomdlali akazange aphendvule ngekukhombisa indlela lecondzile yekubhala emagama.
